name: Growth & Optimization (SDLC Phase 13)
description: Driving product growth and optimization — aka Product-Led Growth, Growth Loops, Experimentation Framework, 1→N Stage.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Growth & Optimization
capabilities.description: Drives measurable product growth through analytics, structured experimentation, and retention optimization.

checklists.statement: Each entry in the growth experiments backlog states a clear hypothesis and a measurable success metric before it is run.
checklists.prompt: Does each growth experiment define a testable hypothesis and a measurable success metric in advance?

reviewGates.statement: The Growth & Optimization's deliverables have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Internationalization & Localization.
reviewGates.prompt: Do the analytics, experimentation results, and retention metrics show sufficient product-market traction to justify moving into Internationalization & Localization?
